title: Design with shared CSS props, not magic numbers
principle: Adam Argyle’s Open Props (open-props.style / GitHub): expose design decisions as CSS custom properties—colors, sizes, shadows, easings—so UI stays consistent and adaptable. For AI output, ban raw one-off px/rem/hex when a prop exists.
procedure: Establish or import a prop set (spacing, type, color, radius, shadow, ease).
Rewrite AI CSS to reference props; delete orphan magic numbers.
Prefer prop packs you can theme (light/dark) over hardcoded values.
Document which props are allowed in prompts to agents.
examplePrompts:
Refactor this stylesheet to Open Props–style tokens (Argyle):
- Replace magic spacing/color/radius/shadow with var(--…).
- Add missing props sparingly; don’t explode the token set.
- Show light/dark where color props need pairs.
Return prop map + diff.
Given these props [paste], generate the card component using ONLY those vars.
promptWhy: Token constraint kills rainbow AI CSS.

workedExamples.title: Dark mode rewrite
workedExamples.body: Color props swap; components untouched—proof tokens worked.

antiPatterns: Hex soup beside an unused token file.
checklist: No unexplained magic numbers in final CSS.
